app.name: Nocturne
app.tagline: It sleeps on it. You wake to one page.

shell.drop.body: Nocturne keeps the originals exactly as they are.
bar.label: Keep something, or ask
bar.hint: A question mark or a question word makes Ask the default; anything else defaults to Keep. Both are always visible so the guess is never a trap.
bar.shortcut.label: Shortcut: {keys}
bar.empty: Type something to keep or ask first.
bar.kept.error: I couldn’t keep that just now. Nothing is lost; try again.
capture.duplicate: You already kept this {kind} on {day}. Nothing new to add.
capture.files: {count, plural, one {Kept # file.} other {Kept # files.}} I’ll read {count, plural, one {it} other {them}} tonight.
capture.recording.failed: I couldn’t keep that voice note just now. It is still here.
capture.mic.unsupported: This computer can’t record sound inside Nocturne. You can still type, or drop a voice note on the window.
capture.mic.failed: I couldn’t start the microphone. Check that nothing else is using it, then try again.
notice.action.failed: That didn’t work. Nothing was lost; try again in a moment.
kept.heading: Kept today · {count}
kept.tonight: Tonight, from about {time} while this computer is plugged in and idle.
kept.tonight.unknown: Tonight, while this computer is plugged in and idle.
duration.about.minutes: about {count, plural, one {# min} other {# min}}
duration.about.seconds: about {count, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}
certainty.sure.hint: confirmed by you or two sources
edition.label: Edition
edition.listen.title: Listen
edition.print.title: Print
page.previous.label: Previous page, {date}
page.section.question: One question
page.more.needsYou: {count, plural, one {# more this week in Needs you} other {# more this week in Needs you}}
page.more.changed: {count, plural, one {# smaller change} other {# smaller changes}}
page.firstNext.title: Tomorrow’s page gets better with
page.firstNext.body: Appointment cards, voice notes after calls, school and work messages. Anything with a date, a promise or a name.
page.line.done: Done. Nocturne will stop reminding you.
page.line.forgotten: Forgotten. This line is gone from the page.
page.which.resolved: {chosen} it is. The other is kept as history, not deleted.
page.unconfirmed.confirmed: Confirmed. Marked as sure because you said so.
page.unconfirmed.denied: Forgotten. The original is still kept; nothing from it is treated as true.
page.letGo.restored: Brought back. It will not fade for 30 days.
page.question.answered.yes.body: Thanks. Nocturne will ask again in a while.
page.question.answered.no.body: What you kept stays as history.
page.question.answered.notSure.body: Nocturne will ask again in a month.
page.question.answered.right: Thanks. The page will keep arriving at {time}.
page.question.answered.earlier: Noted. The page will arrive a little earlier.
page.question.answered.later: Noted. The page will arrive a little later.
page.writing.title: Still writing today’s page
page.writing.past: This page was still being written. Some of what you kept that day may be missing from it.
page.writing.body: Nocturne is reading what you kept. This page fills in as it goes.
page.writing.detail.pending: {pending, plural, one {# thing still to read} other {# things still to read}}
page.catchUp.dek: Catching up on {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
page.privateSkipped: {count, plural, one {# private thing is not shown here.} other {# private things are not shown here.}}
page.action.failed: That did not go through, so nothing was changed. Try again.
page.error: I couldn’t get this page. What you kept is safe.
notice.downloadStalled.text: The download stopped when the internet dropped. It will carry on by itself.
notice.diskFull.text: This computer needs {size} more free space to finish setting up.
notice.diskFull.text.unknown: This computer needs more free space to finish setting up.
notice.tierDropped.text: This computer is short of memory, so Nocturne switched to its smaller mind. Everything still works.
notice.restarts.text: Nocturne had to restart a few times today. It’s fine now, but you may want to restart the computer.
notice.couldntRead.text: I couldn’t read something you kept. Nothing is lost.
notice.micDenied.text: Nocturne can’t hear you. Microphone access is turned off for it.
notice.printFailed.text: The printer didn’t answer, so today’s page wasn’t printed.
notice.catchingUp.text: The computer was off overnight. Catching up now, {eta}.
notice.catchingUp.text.unknown: The computer was off overnight. Catching up now.
notice.repairNeeded.text: Some of what you kept needs a quick repair. Nothing is lost.
notice.notReady.text: Nocturne is still getting ready, so it can’t answer yet. What you keep is safe.
notice.tidyPausedBattery.text: Nocturne paused tidying because the computer is on battery. It will finish when plugged in.
notice.updateRolledBack.text: The update couldn’t finish. Nocturne went back to the version you had.
notice.reReading.text: Nocturne is re-reading what you kept. Nothing is lost, and pages keep arriving.

setup.tonight.body: When this computer is plugged in and idle, Nocturne reads what you kept, links it together and writes your first page. If the lid is closed, it catches up when you open it.
settings.updates.title: Checking for updates
settings.updates.off: Off. Nocturne only checks when you ask.
settings.updates.on: On. Nocturne asks before it downloads anything.
